goal: Audio Loop installs from JSON and renders a runtime audio loop player.
checks: Compiled package declares the audioLoopPlayer widget.
iOS, Android, and web runtimes can select a local audio file and loop playback without upload.
macOS shell lists and opens the package with a native audio player.
Android deep-link/voice intent entry is recognized as a no-op route stub with explicit user confirmation required before playback.
No audio playback or microphone recording starts automatically on intent entry.
